column1: # Looks the mod gives some places only (client/AreaLooks): which look, on which block, over which part of the map
# (x0 z0 to x1 z1, every height). Several rows with the same look and block add their areas together.
# white_fence: solid white with a slight gradient. roof: HeartGold's roof red in rows of tiles along the eaves.
# sign: the shelves stacked as signs become HeartGold's sign (the top row the board, the rows under it the stand).
# grass_edge: the grass's rounded tufts onto the dripstone where it borders water.
